title: Prices & Booking
intro: Choose your dates on the calendar and send us a booking request. We'll reply within a day to confirm, with a secure link to pay your deposit.

seasons.name: Mid
seasons.when: April to June, September and October

prices_note: Minimum stay 3 nights. Dogs £20 per stay. Prices include linen, towels, heating and logs. A 25% deposit secures your booking, and the balance is due 6 weeks before arrival.
calendar_note: This demo uses made-up booked dates. On the real site, the calendar would update automatically from Airbnb.
steps: Send us your dates using the form.
We'll check them and reply within a day.
Pay a 25% deposit through the secure link we send you.
Pay the balance 6 weeks before you arrive.
contact_note: Rather talk to us? Give us a call.
